'''Witersckar''' is the federal administrative language of [[Imperial Rhovland]] and a major language of central [[Viridia]].

== Role In Rhovland ==

The extracted source describes Witersckar as the primary language of Rhovlandian law, diplomacy, education, and federal administration. It is associated with the legacy of the Valderic Empire and with Rhovland's later federal institutions.

== Language Profile ==

Witersckar uses the [[Valderic script]] and has a formal standard associated with St. Blane. The source describes it as a language with complex grammar, extensive compound formation, and a large legal and diplomatic vocabulary.

== Draft Scope ==

This bridge page exists mainly to support [[Imperial Rhovland]] and the northern Viridia draft batch. A fuller language article can later reconcile Witersckar with [[Geslariena]], [[Rontzken]], Valderic history, and Rhovlandian education policy.
